title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Re-Send Limits for Recently Replaced Destinations
content:
# Payments Risk limits — re-sending a returned payout to a new destination

Under Cartwise Shopper Payouts, a re-send of a returned payout draws on a limited amount when the payout destination on file was replaced recently. The limit depends on two figures taken from the payout account's records:

- **Days since the destination was replaced** — counted in calendar days from the moment of the replacement, or from the opening date of the payout account when the destination was never replaced, up to the day of the re-send.
- **Months since verification** — the number of whole months from the account's verification date to the day of the re-send.

## The limit

| Days since replacement (or since opening) | Whole months since verification | The re-send draws on at most |
|---|---|---|
| Fewer than 30 | Fewer than 12 | 100.00 |
| Fewer than 30 | 12 or more | 150.00 |
| 30 or more | Any | The whole amount still to re-send (no limit) |

Formally: where the destination was replaced fewer than 30 days ago and the account was verified fewer than 12 whole months ago, the re-send draws on at most 100.00; where the destination was replaced fewer than 30 days ago and the account was verified 12 or more whole months ago, it draws on at most 150.00; otherwise the re-send draws on the whole amount still to re-send. The amount drawn is never more than the amount still to re-send.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Hypothetical facts | Days since replacement | Whole months since verification | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Destination replaced 29 days before the re-send; verified 11 whole months before | 29 (fewer than 30) | 11 (fewer than 12) | 100.00 |
| Destination replaced 29 days before; verified exactly 12 whole months before | 29 | 12 (12 or more) | 150.00 |
| Destination replaced exactly 30 days before; verified 3 whole months before | 30 (not fewer than 30) | 3 | Whole amount still to re-send |
| Destination never replaced; account opened 20 days before the re-send and verified 18 days before | 20, counted from the opening date | 0 | 100.00 |

*Hypothetical application:* with 130.00 still to re-send, a destination replaced 10 days ago and verification 14 whole months ago, the re-send draws on at most 150.00, so the whole 130.00 is drawn; with verification 5 whole months ago it draws on at most 100.00, so 100.00 is drawn and 30.00 stays on the Cartwise Shopper Payouts balance.
